summary:
This efun is available only when the driver is compiled with __OLD_ED__ defined.

It opens the built-in editor for the specified `file`. The editor is largely compatible with UNIX ed; enter `h` in the editor to view help.

The <write_fn> function allows the mudlib to handle file locks and administrative logging of modified files. Each time the editor writes a file, the driver calls <write_fn> twice. The first call occurs before the write, with <flag> equal to 0. If it returns TRUE, the write proceeds; otherwise the write is aborted. The second call occurs after the write completes, with non-zero <flag>. Its form is:

   int write_fn(string fname, int flag)

When the editor exits, the driver calls <exit_fn> so the mudlib can clean up. Its form is:

   void exit_fn()

The optional <restricted> flag limits editor capabilities, such as inserting another file or saving under a different file name.
